title: 找份差事
note: reward.currency=15 is grounded in worlds/mingyun_zhiyu/data/economy_income.csv's '普通勞工 5-10銅幣/日' row — slightly more than a day's common-labor wage for a one-off delivery, not an invented number. The task is explicit event-driven state progression: dialogue.foreman_laotie.work.offer causes unstarted→available; giving item.firewood_bundle to npc.foreman_laotie causes available→completed and pays the reward. If the player brings the same required bundle before asking, inventory.item_given deterministically completes the quest from unstarted as well, preserving free action ordering without inferring a prose rule.
